issue.instructions: Which category best describes the customer's problem in this online shop support message?

criteria.order_status: Asking where an order is or what its current status is, with no sign it is late or lost
criteria.delivery_delay_missing: Delivery is late past the promised date, or the parcel is lost or marked delivered but not received
criteria.wrong_damaged_item: The item received is not what was ordered (wrong product, size, colour) or arrived damaged or defective
criteria.cancellation: Wants to cancel an order before it is delivered
criteria.return_exchange: Wants to return or exchange a correct, undamaged item (does not fit, changed mind)
criteria.pending_refund: A refund was promised or approved but has not arrived
criteria.payment_failed_debited: Checkout payment failed or showed an error, but money was still deducted
criteria.payment_failed_no_debit: Checkout payment failed or was declined and no money was deducted
criteria.duplicate_debit: Charged more than once for the same order
criteria.product_inquiry: Question about a product before buying: price, specs, stock, warranty
criteria.other: A clear request that fits none of the categories above

clarification.instructions: Before routing this online shop support message, does the agent first need to ask the customer what the problem is?

criteria.true: The message is too vague to identify a problem, or it raises several problems without saying which to handle first
criteria.false: The message states one problem, or says which problem to handle first, or is clearly about something specific

issue.instructions: Which category best describes the customer's problem in this digital wallet support message?

criteria.login_otp: Cannot log in to the wallet app, forgot PIN or password, or the OTP does not arrive
criteria.identity_verification: KYC or identity verification is pending, rejected, or documents are not accepted
criteria.transfer_not_credited: Money left the sender's wallet for another person but the recipient has not received it
criteria.wrong_recipient: Money was sent and credited to the wrong person or number by the customer's mistake
criteria.payment_failed_debited: A payment to a merchant or bill failed or showed an error, but money was still deducted
criteria.payment_failed_no_debit: A payment to a merchant or bill failed or was declined and no money was deducted
criteria.duplicate_debit: The same payment was deducted more than once
criteria.pending_refund: A refund that was promised or started has not arrived in the wallet
criteria.bank_linking: Cannot link, unlink or verify a bank account with the wallet, or load money from a linked bank
criteria.withdrawal_issue: Moving wallet balance out to the customer's own bank account or an agent failed or is stuck
criteria.unexpected_transaction: A transaction the customer does not recognise or says they did not make
criteria.other: A clear request that fits none of the categories above
